subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should the first public WhatsApp sticker action require sticker-ready WebP, or should OpenClaw convert common static and animated media inputs?
rationale: The action name and transport primitive already exist, but accepted inputs, encoding and metadata responsibility, and failure behavior are user-visible API decisions that current code and docs do not settle.

options.title: Validate sticker-ready WebP
options.body: Ship the narrow explicit action with format validation and actionable errors, deferring media conversion to dedicated tools or later work.

options.title: Convert media inputs
options.body: Add plugin-owned static and animated conversion, including required WebP structure and metadata, before calling the sender.

options.title: Keep QA-only
options.body: Treat the existing sender as internal test infrastructure and leave normal agent sticker sends unsupported.

recommendation.title: Validate sticker-ready WebP
recommendation.body: Ship the narrow explicit action with format validation and actionable errors, deferring media conversion to dedicated tools or later work.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current structured sticker sender and have strong recent ownership signals on the same WhatsApp outbound path.
